parameters.content:
## ② Organise & Extract (stage 2 of a run, called by A)
**Which sources**: every source of the domain that passed the screen and has readable text (this run's and earlier runs' queue; the domain is a tag, so sources found by another domain's run can be here too).
**Organise (GPT-6 Sol, one call per run)** reads the screen's card of every queued source (title, authors, organisation, kind of source, deployment, key figures, evidence type, summary) and the known deployments and tools, and returns: (1) for each source the **deployment** (project) it is about, a known one (P-…) or a new one it defines, named *Tool — place/phase*, each deployment under its **tool** (T-…); (2) **duplicates**: the same document found twice (another URL, a preprint, a reprint): kept with the deployment but not analysed; (3) known deployments that are the same one (merged); (4) with an analysis budget (*Max sources to analyse*) and more sources than the budget, the **selection**: as many different deployments as possible, for each the source with the most first-hand, checkable facts, then the default order (stronger evidence, full text). Without a budget every source that is not a duplicate is analysed. If the call fails, the rule-based order is used and C2 links each source itself.
**C2** extracts each chosen source, with its deployment as context. Sources not chosen stay queued, already placed in their deployment.

parameters.query:
-- every source in this domain that passed the screen and is not analysed yet (this run's and earlier runs' queue)
-- (the domain is a tag: a source found by another domain's run waits here too when the screen tagged it with this domain)
SELECT s.id AS source_id, s.run_id, s.country, s.source_type, s.screen_relevance, COALESCE(s.screen->>'project_name', s.project_guess, '') AS project_guess,
       COALESCE(s.screen->>'implementing_org', '') AS org, COALESCE(s.text_chars, 0) AS text_chars, COALESCE(s.text_level, '') AS text_level,
       COALESCE(s.screen->>'evidence_type', '') AS evidence_type, COALESCE(s.database, '') AS database,
       COALESCE(s.screen->>'headline_en', s.title_en, s.title, '') AS headline, COALESCE(s.title, '') AS title, s.url,
       COALESCE(s.screen->'card', '{}'::jsonb) AS card, COALESCE(s.screen->>'reason', '') AS screen_reason,
       p.code AS placed_in, sp.method AS placed_by
FROM sources s
LEFT JOIN source_projects sp ON sp.source_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN ai_projects p ON p.id = sp.project_id
WHERE s.status = 'passed' AND COALESCE(s.text_chars, 0) >= 300
  AND CASE WHEN $1 = '' THEN s.domain IS NULL ELSE $1 = ANY(COALESCE(s.domain_tags, ARRAY[s.domain])) END
ORDER BY s.screen_relevance DESC NULLS LAST, s.id

-- the known deployments the queue may belong to: those with a source of this domain, or in a country of the queue
-- (newest first, at most 300), each with its tool and up to 5 of its sources
WITH q AS (SELECT DISTINCT country FROM sources WHERE id = ANY($2::bigint[]))
SELECT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.aliases, p.implementing_org, p.countries, p.deployment, t.code AS tool_code, t.name AS tool_name,
       (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sid', x.id, 'title', COALESCE(x.screen->>'headline_en', x.title_en, x.title, x.url),
                                                     'status', x.status, 'type', x.source_type) ORDER BY x.id), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM (SELECT s.* FROM source_projects sp JOIN sources s ON s.id = sp.source_id WHERE sp.project_id = p.id ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 5) x) AS sources,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_projects sp WHERE sp.project_id = p.id AND sp.method = 'manual') AS manual
FROM ai_projects p LEFT JOIN ai_tools t ON t.id = p.tool_id
WHERE $1 = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_projects sp JOIN sources s ON s.id = sp.source_id
                         WHERE sp.project_id = p.id AND $1 = ANY(COALESCE(s.domain_tags, ARRAY[s.domain])))
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p.countries) c JOIN q ON lower(q.country) = lower(c))
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT t.code, t.name, t.aliases, t.developer, (SELECT count(*) FROM ai_projects p WHERE p.tool_id = t.id) AS deployments
FROM ai_tools t ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC LIMIT 500

-- deployments, tools, duplicates and the selection, in the database (function in db/pipeline-schema.sql); returns the queue in order
SELECT * FROM ai4sg_apply_organisation($1::jsonb, NULLIF($2, '')::bigint, $3)
